ops.title: cc-guides is a Go binary at /opt/homebrew/bin/cc-guides — not on PyPI, uvx cc-guides fails; render re-pins the lock to current cc-skills@main unavoidably
ops.body:
`cc-guides` (the fragment renderer behind every fleet repo's AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md/settings artifacts) is a Go binary installed via Homebrew at `/opt/homebrew/bin/cc-guides`. It is NOT on PyPI — `uvx cc-guides` fails; never put that in an agent brief (six sweep agents hit this 2026-07-17 and had to recover).

Also: layout.toml pins cc-skills at the moving `@main` ref, so any `cc-guides render` re-pins `cc-guides.lock` to the CURRENT cc-skills main and can pull unrelated upstream fragment wording into the rendered artifacts. This is unavoidable — `cc-guides check` validates against lock-recorded pins, so pinning back to an older commit corrupts the lock and fails the Guides CI gate. Expect and commit the drift.
